description: Find STEP part files in a folder that are the same part: identical copies, re-exports, or the same part moved or rotated, whatever the file names. Also reports left/right (mirror-image) pairs. Use it to clean up a messy project folder, find which supplier file matches which drawing, or avoid making the same part twice. Files are read locally and never uploaded. Only files whose fingerprints match are compared in full, so large folders are feasible; typical time is 0.1–1 s per file plus 0.3–5 s per comparison. Assemblies are skipped (listed in skipped). Requires CAD Compare Pro (see describe → license).

folder.description: Absolute path to a folder on this computer

max_files.description: Check at most this many files (default 200), in name order

name: find_duplicates

groups.description: Sets of files that are the same part; files in no group are unique

relation.description: Compared with the group's first file (reference): identical, or the same part moved/rotated

mirror_pairs.description: Left/right versions: b is a mirror image of a (not duplicates)

warnings.description: truncated:<checked>/<found> when the folder has more files than max_files
